SirFay WardrobeCanada → Nigeria
Offline

The rack.

Every piece on the list, the real thing on a hanger. Tap one to see the fabric up close, the price, the sizes and where it's from.

Everything.

Every item in one list. Tap a name to open the store's page, tap the picture for the full details, tick the circle when it's bought.

In the store.

The checklist for the shopping trip, grouped by store. Type the shelf price to compare, tick it when it's in the bag.

Add a piece.

Paste a product link. The app fills in what it can find: name, brand, price, discount, sizes, material, where it's from.

No details came through? Paste the product page

On the product page: select all (Ctrl+A, or long-press and Select all), copy, and paste here. The app reads the price, sizes and the rest out of the text. Works offline.

Add many links at once

Paste any number of product links, one per line. Each becomes an item; open it afterwards to check the details.

Product photo

Copy the photo on the store page,
then paste here (Ctrl+V / ⌘V),
drop it, or choose a file.

Keep it on the phone

Saves a new copy of this app with every item and photo inside. Send it to the phone and open it in Chrome: no internet needed in the store.

"By file name": name a photo after the item (jeans.jpg, nb550.jpg, tee.jpg…) and add many at once.

SirFay Wardrobe · Everything is saved inside this browser, and inside any offline copy you save.
